# Supanta

> Supanta is an AI-powered customer operations partner. We combine AI-driven resolution with skilled human agents on one platform, so businesses can run customer support, technical support, workflow automation, and data/CRM and back-office operations without switching tools or vendors.

Supanta is not a chatbot vendor and not a traditional BPO — we build the AI platform and run the operation ourselves, under one roof, accountable for one outcome. We integrate with existing CRMs and helpdesks (HubSpot, Zendesk, and others) rather than requiring customers to replace their stack. Supanta is POPIA-compliant and operates in line with UK GDPR requirements, serving businesses globally.

## Pages

- [Home](https://supanta.com/): Overview of Supanta's AI-powered customer operations platform and what it does.
- [About](https://supanta.com/about): Why Supanta exists and how it differs from chatbot vendors and traditional BPOs.
- [Services](https://supanta.com/services): The six service lines — customer support operations, AI-powered customer resolution, workflow automation, data and CRM operations, back office operations, and technical support — all on one platform.
- [Contact](https://supanta.com/contact): How to get in touch and request a scoped plan/quote.

## Notes

- The client dashboard (https://supanta.com/app) is a private, authenticated application and is not part of the public site — it is excluded from indexing.
